You can open several of each, and they all come back after a restart. The old Browser and Side chat panel is gone, and the bottom terminal (⌘J) stays.

I fixed the four problems the last review found in the tab work, and the fixes are now on `brigadier/9a2b00c9/session`.

- **Side chats were being deleted:** the clean-up step removed side chats that plain chats created before this change. It now removes only unused side chats that belong to sessions.
- **Terminals could not reattach:** a shell that was still running couldn't be reopened if its folder had been deleted. It now reattaches.
- **False unsaved warning:** closing an empty, never-edited new file asked about unsaved changes. It no longer does.
- **Browser tab overhead:** while a browser tab is showing, it reacted to every change on the page, such as streaming chat output. It now watches only the top level of the page, where menus and dialogs appear.

The desktop checks (190 tests) and the daemon tests, formatting and lint all pass. In a plain chat, the ⌘T, ⌘⇧B, ⌥⌘S and ⌥⌘N menu items still exist but do nothing. Disabling them needs a new connection from the app to the native menu, so I left that out.

Once you've tried it in the app, should I merge `brigadier/9a2b00c9/session` into `main`?
